name: df-script
description: A zero-dependency, high-performance, expression-based DataFrame library for TypeScript/JavaScript.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --minify-whitespace --minify-identifiers --minify-syntax --target=es2020 --tree-shaking=true --drop:console --drop:debugger --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/index.js --platform=node --mangle-props=^_ && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --minify-whitespace --minify-identifiers --minify-syntax --target=es2020 --tree-shaking=true --drop:console --drop:debugger --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/index.mjs --platform=neutral --format=esm --external:fs --mangle-props=^_ && esbuild src/utils/index.ts --bundle --minify --minify-whitespace --minify-identifiers --minify-syntax --target=es2020 --tree-shaking=true --drop:console --drop:debugger --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/utils.js --platform=node --mangle-props=^_ && esbuild src/utils/index.ts --bundle --minify --minify-whitespace --minify-identifiers --minify-syntax --target=es2020 --tree-shaking=true --drop:console --drop:debugger --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/utils.mjs --platform=neutral --format=esm --external:fs --mangle-props=^_ && esbuild src/columnExpressions/index.ts --bundle --minify --minify-whitespace --minify-identifiers --minify-syntax --target=es2020 --tree-shaking=true --drop:console --drop:debugger --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/expressions.js --platform=node --mangle-props=^_ && esbuild src/columnExpressions/index.ts --bundle --minify --minify-whitespace --minify-identifiers --minify-syntax --target=es2020 --tree-shaking=true --drop:console --drop:debugger --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/expressions.mjs --platform=neutral --format=esm --external:fs --mangle-props=^_ && node scripts/extract-docs.mjs

author: Trent Morris
